warnings.message: the forbid guard is registered for Claude Code and Codex only; Gemini keeps each flags-anywhere forbid in its prefix form (adapters/gemini)
sandbox.writable_roots write ~/.cache/pnpm dropped on gemini: container mounts are the launcher's job

accepted.message: YOLO is a launch flag, and no page states that a user-tier deny outranks its auto-approval
accepted.reason: YOLO only inside the devbox container, measured against a deny probe before use

accepted.message: read denies reach only the file tools (read_file, read_many_files, glob, search_file_content; names unverified), not run_shell_command reads
accepted.reason: Gemini runs in a container without the secret files mounted

accepted.message: command ["git","push"] with --force | -f | --mirror | +* anywhere: commandPrefix matches the start of the command, so only the flag right after the words is denied, not the flags anywhere later in it
accepted.reason: shell redirection into .git/hooks is denied by the project hook

accepted.message: command ["docker","compose","down"] with -v | --volumes anywhere: commandPrefix matches the start of the command, so only the flag right after the words is denied, not the flags anywhere later in it
accepted.reason: shell redirection into .git/hooks is denied by the project hook

accepted.message: command ["docker-compose","down"] with -v | --volumes anywhere: commandPrefix matches the start of the command, so only the flag right after the words is denied, not the flags anywhere later in it
accepted.reason: shell redirection into .git/hooks is denied by the project hook

accepted.message: write **/.git/hooks/**: a deny reaches the file tools (write_file, replace) only, not shell redirection
accepted.reason: shell redirection into .git/hooks is denied by the project hook

accepted.message: the sandbox offers open or proxied profiles, not a domain list
accepted.reason: the container's proxy enforces the domain list
the launcher refuses to start without the container, which mounts no gh or npm credentials

accepted.message: gemini reports no cost: max_usd 20 is not metered; the run is bounded by max_turns
accepted.reason: the devbox's spend is watched by the operator, who is reachable; neither engine reports cost

notes: bypass tier devbox requires: prod-unreachable-from-this-host, non-root-container (harness check-requires probes each on the host; harness run refuses the profile's runs until they pass)
